0.1.1.description:
### Added
- AP client now creates a local save file (in `BepInEx/config/ChantsOfSennaarAP`) to record received checks and properly sync items with the server

### Fixed
- Received items are now reapplied when a user restarts or changes save files
- AP client GUI now displays only after splash screen has ended
0.1.1.title: Pre-alpha [0.1.1] - 2026-10-29

0.2.0.description:
Floor 1 has now been implemented for ChantsOfSennaarAP!
All runes, journal pages, and most key items reachable on Floor 1 have now been included as AP locations and items.

**IMPORTANT:**
This update is **not** backwards-compatible with 0.1.x components.
Please update both the mod and the apworld before playing this update.

### Added
- 35 new runes as AP items and location checks
- 9 new pages as AP location checks
- 4 new key items as AP

### Changed
- [!] APWorld item and location IDs have been updated
- [!] Maximum value for YAML option `journal_hunt_page_count` has been changed to 10
- Default value for YAML option `journal_hunt_page_count` has been changed to 8
- Progression past the Crypt Valves is no longer gated behind Devotee Journal Page 01
- Default filler item name is now Gibberish
